feeds.title: Alisa Jaffe Holleron
feeds.description: My own experience, the experience of my co-parenting students, and an intense desire to study and learn new ways of helping parents after divorce helped me develop a unique and powerful approach to divorced co-parenting. This approach is the basis for my curriculum and my book An Unexpected Journey: The Road to Power and Wisdom in Divorced Co-Parenting. I developed the online class to reach co-parents that don't live close by! I also teach my approach to other professionals all over the country.

feeds.description: Co-Parenting Solutions provides a multi-level approach to services that focuses on reducing parental conflict in order to enhance the child's emotional functioning.
